label: sec:variational-equations-intro
html: The canonical action \mathfrak{S}_q depends on the Frobenius form \int_A, the connection \nabla, and the state \psi. Varying each yields one of the three classical field equations in categorical form: the categorical Einstein equation, the categorical Yang--Mills equation, and the categorical transport equation. The transport equation governs the spatial propagation of states, combining parallel transport and Reeb diffraction. Tracing this propagation through a double-slit geometry predicts a material-dependent torsion phase shift.
